row.body: A crate tally includes the offices but lists no contents; the next page labels the same shipment for a field check.
row.title: Crates without contents

cites.quote: crates all around, could be filled with stuff

sidecar.gloss: A field check is linked to crates whose contents were never recorded.

row.body: Warehouse note: keep the empty crates for soil cores from the southern trial farms. Three returned damp and smelling of solvent, though the manifest lists them unused.
row.title: Crates reserved for field samples

sidecar.rival_reading: A disaster-response worker could have made the same observation; this personal paper does not identify who directed the work.
